description: Adds a page to the website

display.description: Integer on where to show the page in the navigation. 0 = hidden, 1 = top and bottom (default), 2 = top, 3 = bottom

footer.description: Body content as HTML, below normal page content. Only used on default pages (1-5).

header.description: Body content as HTML, above normal page content.

lang.description: Language in ISO 639-1. Choose from: cs, da, de, el, en, es, fi, fr, it, ja, ko, nl, no, pl, pt, ro, ru, sv, tr, zh (traditional Chinese). Optional, defaults to default website language.

location.description: Page location. 1 = Home, 2 = Webshop, 3 = Info, 4 = Contact, 5 = My account, 100-999 = extra pages. Optional: leave empty to asign automatically.

navigation.description: Page title shown in website navigation.

title.description: Page title shown in browser title.

name: create_page
title: Create page
